jobs.description:
Pay: CA$20.00-CA$30.00 per hour
Location: 66 Bullock Dr, Markham, ON L3P 3P2

Swim/Aquatic Instructors – Markham, ON

Make Waves with WD Swim!

WD Swim is seeking enthusiastic and dedicated Swim/Aquatic Instructors to join our team in Markham. If you’re passionate about swimming, fitness, and creating a fun, safe, and supportive environment for all ages, we’d love to meet you!

About the Role
As a Swim/Aquatic Instructor, you’ll deliver engaging and effective aquatic lessons for swimmers of all ages and skill levels. Your enthusiasm, professionalism, and care will help every participant feel confident and excited in the water.

What You’ll Bring

  • A passion for swimming and helping others succeed
  • Experience teaching small swim groups (up to 4 students) is an asset
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Current Standard First Aid & CPR-C , National Lifeguard, & Swimming Instructor certification (required)
  • A positive attitude and willingness to learn — full training provided
  • Reliability, teamwork, and a commitment to safety
  • Availability for evening (Mon–Fri) and/or weekend (Sat–Sun) shifts

Work Setup

  • Part-time: Up to 20 hours/week
  • Full-time: 30+ hours/week

Additional Information

  • Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted
  • Applicants must be legally eligible to work in Canada

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion
WD Swim is an equal opportunity employer. We’re dedicated to creating an inclusive and welcoming environment and encourage individuals of all backgrounds, identities, and abilities to apply.

Ready to Dive In?
Join a team that’s passionate about water, wellness, and building confidence — one swimmer at a time! Apply today to make waves with WD Swim.

jobs.title: Administrative Assistant & Front Desk Receptionist
jobs.description:
Administrative Assistant & Front Desk Receptionist

Company: WD Swim
Location: 563 Edward Ave, Richmond Hill, ON L4C 9W7, Canada
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Pay: CA$22.00–CA$28.00 per hour
Schedule: Must be available to work weekends
Reports To: Operations Manager

About WD Swim

WD Swim is a swim school serving families and swimmers across the Greater Toronto Area. We provide quality swimming lessons for children and adults of all ages and skill levels, with a strong commitment to safety, customer service, and creating a welcoming environment for our swimmers, families, and team members.

We are looking for a friendly, organized, and detail-oriented Administrative Assistant & Front Desk Receptionist to support our daily operations and deliver an excellent experience for every family who interacts with our team.

Position Overview

The Administrative Assistant & Front Desk Receptionist is responsible for managing front desk operations, assisting customers, coordinating swim lesson registrations, and providing administrative support to management and staff.

As the first point of contact for parents, swimmers, and visitors, you will play an important role in maintaining an organized, professional, and customer-focused environment. The ideal candidate is proactive, dependable, comfortable with computers, and able to manage multiple tasks while maintaining a high standard of service.

Key Responsibilities

Front Desk & Customer Service

  • Greet and assist parents, swimmers, visitors, and staff in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Answer phone calls, respond to emails, and handle in-person inquiries regarding swim programs, lesson schedules, registrations, and facility policies.
  • Provide accurate information about services, class availability, schedules, and general inquiries.
  • Address customer concerns professionally and escalate issues to management when necessary.
  • Maintain a welcoming, organized, and professional front desk environment.

Administrative Support & Office Operations

  • Perform daily administrative duties, including data entry, document preparation, filing, scanning, and record maintenance.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer information, registration records, and administrative files.
  • Assist management with scheduling, internal communications, reports, and other administrative tasks.
  • Coordinate information between parents, swim instructors, and management to support smooth daily operations.
  • Monitor administrative tasks and follow up on outstanding inquiries or requests.

Swim Lesson Registration & Payment Processing

  • Assist with swim lesson registrations, class bookings, schedule changes, cancellations, and customer check-ins.
  • Process payments, issue receipts, and assist with basic billing and account inquiries.
  • Update registration systems and customer records accurately.
  • Communicate class schedules, program updates, and relevant announcements to parents and customers.
  • Help ensure registration and front desk procedures are followed consistently.

Operational Support

  • Follow company policies, procedures, and confidentiality requirements.
  • Identify and report scheduling discrepancies, customer service concerns, and operational issues to management.
  • Assist with general office coordination and other reasonable administrative duties as required.

Why Join WD Swim?

  • Competitive hourly compensation of CA$22.00–CA$28.00.
  • Supportive and team-oriented work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Ongoing training and opportunities to develop administrative and customer service skills.
  • The opportunity to contribute to a growing organization that supports swimming education and water safety.

How to Apply

If you are organized, dependable, and passionate about providing excellent customer service, we would love to hear from you.

Apply today to join WD Swim and become an important part of the team supporting our swimmers, families, and daily operations.

jobs.title: Aquatics Manager Assistant
jobs.description:
Pay: CA$25.00-CA$30.00 per hour

Company: White Dolphin Swim (WD Swim)
Location: Richmond Hill, Ontario
Job Type: Full-time/Part-time (Permanent)
Reports To: Aquatic Manager
Compensation: $25 - $30 per hour

Job Overview

White Dolphin Swim (WD Swim) is looking for a motivated and hands-on Aquatics Manager Assistant to support the daily operations of our swim school. This role is ideal for someone with a background in aquatics, swimming instruction, lifeguarding, or sports coaching who is ready to take the next step into aquatic leadership and management.

Working closely with the Aquatic Manager, you will help oversee swim programs, coordinate staff schedules, support and supervise aquatic staff, and maintain high standards of water safety and program quality. You will play an important role in ensuring that swimming lessons run smoothly, instructors are supported, and swimmers and families have a safe, positive, and enjoyable experience.

We are looking for a dependable, organized, and proactive individual with strong swimming skills, sound judgment, and a passion for developing people and delivering high-quality aquatic programs.

Key Responsibilities

Aquatic Operations and Program Coordination

  • Support the day-to-day operations of the swim school, including pool activities, swimming lessons, and aquatic programs.
  • Coordinate swim lesson schedules, staff assignments, pool usage, and coverage to ensure smooth and timely program delivery.
  • Monitor ongoing classes and daily operations to maintain program quality and consistency.
  • Assist with planning and implementing swim programs, training activities, and special aquatic events.

Staff Supervision and Development

  • Provide day-to-day guidance and support to swim instructors, lifeguards, and deck supervisors.
  • Help ensure staff follow established procedures, teaching standards, and organizational policies.
  • Assist with staff onboarding, training, performance feedback, and ongoing development, as assigned.
  • Help address staffing concerns, scheduling conflicts, and operational challenges promptly and professionally.

Water Safety and Risk Management

  • Monitor pool activities and help maintain a safe environment for swimmers, staff, and guests.
  • Reinforce water safety practices and ensure staff follow applicable safety procedures.
  • Respond appropriately to incidents and emergencies within the scope of training and certification.
  • Assist with incident documentation, reporting, and follow-up actions.

Administration and Reporting

  • Maintain accurate records relating to staff schedules, attendance, certifications, and program operations.
  • Assist with operational reports, data tracking, and internal communications.
  • Communicate effectively with management and aquatic staff regarding scheduling, program delivery, and operational needs.
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflow, staff coordination, safety practices, and the overall swimmer experience.

What We're Looking For

We are seeking a proactive and approachable leader who enjoys working in a hands-on aquatic environment. The ideal candidate takes initiative, supports their teammates, communicates effectively, and understands the importance of balancing operational efficiency with swimmer safety and customer satisfaction.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced swim instructor, lifeguard, or aquatic supervisor looking to grow into a management role within a swim school.

Schedule

This is an on-site position requiring flexible availability, including weekday evenings and weekends, according to swim program schedules and operational requirements.

How to Apply

If you are passionate about aquatics, team leadership, and creating safe and positive swimming experiences, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Bask is the best telehealth platform on the market. Our mission is to empower entrepreneurs and businesses to launch a DTC telemedicine company quickly and easily, abstracting away the complexities of the industry into an easy-to-use platform. With hundreds of features to meet the unique needs of telehealth, we put all the tools in our customers' hands for success. We are a rapidly growing startup, and we work with care and intention to create a high-performance company with the following in mind:

  • Speed Wins. Make decisions, move quickly, and know that if things go wrong, it's okay for you and the company.
  • Intuition, Then Data. We're a data-driven company. We start with our instincts and then use data to validate our decisions and improve
  • Miles, Not Inches. Thinking small is a self-fulfilling prophecy. Favor bold ideas over incremental changes
  • Customer-Obsession. We are obsessed with helping all our customers launch multi-billion-dollar companies with ease. We accomplish this by knowing our customers incredibly well and finding ways to make their businesses better.
  • Ownership & Accountability, together. We embody a culture of extreme ownership, accountability, and teamwork. We count on every team member to take responsibility for their work, embrace a proactive mindset to overcome challenges, and work together to achieve our collective success

A look into the day to day:

  • Building logic based questionnaires (asynchronous visits) through the Bask software (if you have experience with building logic based workflows, you’ll be great at this!)
  • Helping customers launch and upsell medications from start to to finish
  • Triaging bask software and order related questions and issues that come up for any of your accounts, any time of the day

We're Looking For

A self-starter who is passionate about enhancing the customer experience; you take pride in demonstrating the value of the products and services to your customers. You think outside of the box, excel at creative problem-solving, and are comfortable taking on projects that you have potentially never done before! You are a people-person - empathetic, self-aware, low ego, and extremely positive - and are comfortable working in a small collaborative team where you'll wear many hats. You are passionate and proficient in written and spoken communications.

Customer Success at Bask Health is AI-first and customer-obsessed. Work starts in an LLM to clarify intent and context, moves into research and execution, is validated with real patients and partners, and is continuously refined as we learn. AI and self-serve research are default parts of the workflow, not side experiments.

We are looking for Customer Success people who take full ownership of their accounts, treat AI as a real collaborator, and care deeply about the patient and provider experience.

What You'll Do

  • Work AI-first: Use LLMs as your starting point to draft communications, structure problems, and think through customer needs. Apply your own judgment to refine the output and make it human.
  • Validate with real customers and iterate: Test your approaches with real patients, providers, and partners. Use what you learn to improve how we serve them — before issues become patterns.
  • Make automation legible and trustworthy: Help customers understand what Bask's platform is doing on their behalf. Communicate clearly and proactively to build trust while keeping their experience simple.

Share AI-native workflows: Document prompts, processes, and workflows that work. Share them across the Customer Success team so we raise the bar together.

In this job, you will:

  • Build strong relationships with Bask’s customers and own the full customer lifecycle, including onboarding, value realization, engagement strategies, expansion, and renewals
  • Partner with customer stakeholders to develop custom engagement initiatives that drive user adoption and support the unique needs of their patients
  • Manage all current customer data
  • Analyze customer engagement metrics and use them to communicate value, trends, and opportunities with key stakeholders
  • Deliver program demos, provide insightful technical answers, and recommend creative ways to get the most out of the Bask platform
  • Finding comfort in working in a fast-paced startup environment
  • Believing no task is too small and no task is too tall

jobs.title: Client Success Manager for Meta Advertising and Appointment-Setting Agency
jobs.description:
Client Success Manager

Location: Remote, Canada (preferred) or United States
Employment Type: Full-Time, Independent Contractor
Schedule: Monday–Friday, approximately 9 AM–5 PM (Eastern, Central, or Pacific Time)
Base Compensation: USD $60,000–$70,000 per year
Target OTE: Approximately USD $80,000–$90,000 per year, negotiable based on experience
Performance Incentives: Mainly tied to quarterly client retention, with additional bonuses for client testimonials

About the Company

Our client is a done-for-you Meta advertising and appointment-setting agency. It supports medspas and aesthetic wellness businesses across the United States. As its client portfolio grows, the agency is hiring a dedicated Client Success Manager to build a consistent, proactive experience for clients after the sale.

The Opportunity

You’ll own the experience of about 40 agency clients. That covers onboarding, campaign launch, ongoing service, retention, and renewal support. You’ll be clients’ main point of contact and the bridge between them and the creative, media buying, appointment-setting, sales, and operations teams.

This is a client relationship and coordination role. It is not a hands-on media buying position. You’ll also help shape the agency’s first dedicated Client Success function, including the processes and playbook the team will rely on as it scales.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead structured client onboarding, coordinate handoffs from sales to delivery, set expectations, and document client goals and success metrics.
  • Manage a portfolio of about 40 client relationships through scheduled check-ins.
  • Respond to client Slack messages within 24 hours on business days.
  • Keep CRM records accurate and up to date.
  • Spot dissatisfaction and at-risk accounts early, coordinate recovery plans, and support renewals and retention.
  • Turn client concerns into clear actions for the creative, media buying, appointment-setting, and operations teams, and follow through until they’re resolved.
  • Prepare client-facing performance updates and maintain a portfolio health dashboard that leadership can see.
  • Improve onboarding checklists and SOPs, and build a repeatable Client Success playbook.
  • Track retention, NPS trends, response times, and onboarding SLAs.

What Success Looks Like

  • Annual client retention of 93% or higher.
  • Every new-client onboarding completed within agreed SLAs.
  • Every client contacted according to the established check-in schedule.
  • Client interactions logged in the CRM within 24 hours, and churn risks identified before they escalate.

Your First 90 Days

  • Days 1–30: Learn the client journey, tools, account history, and existing team workflows.
  • Days 31–60: Begin managing about 10–20 accounts on your own, set up regular check-ins, and track account health.
  • Days 61–90: Work toward full portfolio ownership, report on retention health, and recommend process improvements.

Earning Potential

  • Base: USD $60,000–$70,000 per year.
  • Variable: Performance incentives are mainly tied to quarterly client retention, with additional bonuses for client testimonials. Detailed retention bonus tiers will be shared before the offer stage.
  • Target OTE: The total target earning opportunity is approximately USD $80,000–$90,000 per year, negotiable based on experience. Earnings above base depend on performance and are not guaranteed.

• Fully remote role for candidates in Canada or the United States.

  • Training on the agency’s platforms, including GoHighLevel, ClickUp, and Meta Ads Manager.
  • Chance to help build the agency’s first dedicated Client Success function and shape its processes and playbook.
  • Room to grow as the agency scales, with potential paths to Senior Client Success Manager and Head of Client Success.
jobs.requirementsSection:
What We’re Looking For

  • About 1–2 years of relevant experience in client success, account management, customer service, or a client-facing agency role. Exceptional transferable experience will also be considered.
  • Excellent spoken and written English, with confident client communication.
  • Empathy, sound judgment, and a strong sense of ownership.
  • Strong organization and follow-through while managing multiple accounts and competing priorities.
  • Proactive problem-solving and comfort working with distributed teams in a fast-moving environment.
  • Ability to understand basic marketing performance reports and explain practical next steps to clients.
  • Based in Canada (preferred) or the United States.
  • Available Monday–Friday, approximately 9 AM–5 PM Eastern, Central, or Pacific Time.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with medspas, aesthetics, or wellness, or experience supporting growth at a medspa.
  • Familiarity with GoHighLevel, ClickUp or similar project management tools, and Meta Ads Manager. These platforms can be taught.

company.title: Limitless Agency
company.description:
Limitless Agency is a Tampa-based business coaching and consulting company built for digital marketing agency owners who are done playing small.

Founded by Gill Valerio — who has generated over $30 million in personal revenue online and completed multiple agency exits — Limitless exists to help agency owners build recurring revenue, systemize their operations, and create real enterprise value that leads to a life-changing exit.

We're not a course. We're not a mastermind. We're a high-performance coaching program backed by a team of operators, strategists, and coaches who've lived the agency grind and come out the other side.

Our clients aren't just growing month-over-month MRR — they're building assets. Sellable, scalable businesses that give them leverage, freedom, and options.

Limitless Agency is also the parent company of Limitless Capital, our private equity arm focused on acquiring and scaling digital marketing agencies. We don't just teach this — we do it.

If you want to work somewhere that moves fast, holds a high standard, and actually cares about the outcomes it produces for clients, this is that place. We're a lean, execution-focused team growing quickly, and we're bringing on people who want to grow with us.

jobs.description:
OUR STORY


For more than 35 years, Bardel Entertainment has been growing and evolving, yet at our core, we remain grounded in the creative roots of the craft of animation.  Our pursuit of fresh ideas, techniques, and technologies is driven by the belief that together, through creativity and collaboration, we can accomplish anything!  If you want to be part of an environment that empowers you to experiment, learn, and contribute to exciting projects, come and join us.

jobs.benefitsSection:
Location: While we welcome application from anywhere, candidates in BC or Quebec, Canada will be given priority.

Dates: ASAP - December 18, 2026

Pay Range: CAD $1,800 - $2,300 per week   

This salary range reflects our current expectations for these roles as of this posting’s date. Your final salary offer will consider various key factors, including your education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographical location, as well as the needs and requirements of the business. 

Flexible work environment, Extended Health and Wellness from day 1, RRSP matching are just some of the benefits. For more details, check out our website. 

At Bardel, we recognize that flexibility is key to doing great work. Our hybrid work environment is a valued perk designed to support individual accountability and empower our teams to work where they’re most productive. We offer the choice to work remotely, balanced with intentional in-person time for collaboration, creativity, and team building. This role requires in-studio attendance at our Vancouver studio during onboarding and predetermined Rush Weeks. 

 

If this seems like a good fit, what are you waiting for, get your application in!
jobs.requirementsSection:
What You’ll Do 

Core Responsibilities 

  • Develop and execute complex character effects such as hair, fur, cloth, and muscle simulations using Houdini. 
  • Collaborate closely with the modeling, rigging, animation, and lighting departments to ensure seamless integration of character effects. 
  • Create tools and scripts to optimize and streamline CFX workflows. 
  • Troubleshoot and solve technical issues related to CFX to ensure smooth production flow. 
  • Maintain and support existing CFX setups and pipelines. 
  • Work with the CFX Lead to meet project deadlines and ensure the quality of work is consistent with the studio’s standards. 
  • Stay updated with the latest industry trends and techniques in character effects and simulation. 

Collaboration & Workflow 

  • Collaborate with leadership, production, and team members to solve problems and share insights. 
  • Engage in dailies, rounds, and team discussions to contribute to creative and technical improvements. 
  • Adhere to pipeline workflows and technical requirements for seamless integration into the production process. 
  • For senior artists, actively mentor junior team members by providing constructive feedback, guidance, and support. 

Time Management & Communication 

  • Maintain consistency in quality while meeting production needs. 
  • Manage time effectively, working with production to stay on schedule. 
  • Keep the team and production staff informed about progress, challenges, and solutions. 

What You’ll Bring 

Experience 

  • Proven experience as a CFX Artist in a feature film or high-end television production environment. 
  • Proficiency in Houdini for character effects, including cloth, hair, fur, and muscle systems. 
  • Strong understanding of physics, dynamics, and procedural animation techniques. 
  • Proficiency in Python, VEX, or other scripting languages commonly used in Houdini is a plus. 
  • Familiarity with other relevant software such as Maya, Nuke, and Marvelous Designer is a plus. 

Skills & Communication 

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to take directions and work independently. 
  • A degree or diploma in Computer Animation, Visual Effects, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred but not required based on experience. 
  • Demo reel showcasing your work in character effects, specifically highlighting your use of Houdini. Portfolio Tips. 
  • Breakdown of your contributions to each project/shot featured in your demo reel. 
  • Any relevant side projects or personal work demonstrate your skills and creativity.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Co-Op – General Accounting
Date Posted: October 26, 2026
Closing Date: November 16, 2026
Job Type: Student

Location: Calgary

Powering a bright future starts with you! 

At AltaLink, people are at the heart of our success. We are a team committed to doing the right thing for each other and our customers. We foster an environment that is inclusive, collaborative and high performing and we value personal accountability. Our people are empowered to continuously improve, deliver outstanding customer service and make a meaningful impact every day. We embrace the unique identities, experiences and perspectives of our workforce, reflecting the communities where we operate. Everyone at AltaLink can expect to work in a safe, respectful environment where trust and commitment are at the core of how we operate.  

Oh, and, what do we do? 

We power Alberta! Our transmission lines deliver electricity to millions of Albertans 24 hours a day, seven days a week. When you’re on our team, you’re supporting Alberta’s homes, farms, businesses and industries by providing the safe, reliable and affordable electricity they rely on. Whether working in the field or in the office, every AltaLinker contributes to keeping the lights on. Want to join our team? We’re excited to share that we are hiring for a Co-Op Student to join our General Accounting team.

 

NOTE: The start date for this position is September 2027 for 12 months.

Job Description:

Reporting to the Manager, General Accounting, the successful candidate will work on daily task and projects in areas such as accounts payable, accounts receivable, capital assets and financial reporting.

Responsibilities:

  • Primarily support Accounting Payable team
  • Scanning invoices to the automated AP system;
  • Processing of invoices and purchase orders;
  • Checking of reports;
  • Monitor and processing emails in the accounting inbox;
  • Vendor set up and modification.
  • Communication with vendors and problem solving.
  • Other vacation coverage and special project responsibilities will vary depending upon the projects, which are assigned, but may include reconciliations of accounts, analysis,
  • Communication with other departments and problem solving.
  • Verifying and entering journal entries; and
  • Carrying out special projects or other duties as assigned which may include reconciliations, analysis, etc.
  • All candidates must demonstrate key behaviors and meet identified expectations outlined in our four cultural pillars – one team, continuous improvement, customer focus and personal accountability.

company.description:
With more than 13,300 kilometres of transmission line and 311 substations, AltaLink is Alberta’s largest regulated electricity transmission provider. Millions of Albertans count on us for the energy that powers their lives. We take that responsibility seriously.

With a future driven by technology, a push to achieve net zero emissions, and the increasing electrification of society, the grid will play a larger role in our lives than ever before.

Through it all, we remain focused on ensuring that safe, reliable and cost-effective electricity is available to all Albertans. It’s what we’ve always done.
